audio.processing: Exact PCM-byte slice only; no gain, normalization, limiting, fades, resampling, recomposition or time stretching.

picture.indexing: Zero based; frame f represents audio samples [f*735,(f+1)*735).
picture.eventRule: relativeSample=sourceSampleFrame-882000; frame60=relativeSample//735; time=relativeSample/44100. Authoritative samples override rounded source time.

systems.cable: Cyan-white signal head and dim trail travel major copper routes; travel speed rises on the overload timeline after 5.5 seconds.
systems.kick: Broad power rail / processor package compression-release; no global brightness pumping.
systems.beast: Amber central processor aperture patterns follow syllable identity, duration and phrase interaction.
systems.branch: Ratchet and percussion launch connected fine-route fan-out; activity, speed and complexity increase without full-frame strobes.
systems.blackout: All image layers become exact black at frame456, held through frame479.
systems.metadata: Audited source context with no independent rendered accent.

visualImplementation.renderer: render.py; original scene geometry and calibrated projections are produced by scene.py.
visualImplementation.geometry: work/scene.json contains all 56 physical main routes, their connected branches, 48 die tiles, core outline and camera calibration. No external geometry or imagery is used.
visualImplementation.routeField: Each event route is a deterministic route-group index in [0,15], derived from that system's source-event ordinal modulo 16. It is not the physical route ID.

physicalRoutes.cable: For j in range(count), physicalRoute=((route%4)*14+(route//4)*3+j)%56. count=3 before 5.5 seconds and 4 from 5.5 seconds onward.
physicalRoutes.openingCableException: For the event at relative sample 0, count=16 and physicalRoute=((j%4)*14+(j//4)*3)%56, j=0..15.
physicalRoutes.branch: physicalRoute=(route*3+j*14)%56; j=0..1 before 5.5 seconds, j=0..2 from 5.5 to 7.0 seconds, j=0..3 from 7.0 seconds onward. The main route's first four points share a junction with branchScreen; the two outgoing arms split at that physical junction.

timing.activation: selected event enters the containing picture frame frame60; compositor age=max(1/600,(frame+1)/60-time), preventing a one-frame ceil delay.
timing.branchTravelDuration: 0.52/(1+max(0,t-5.5)*1.3) seconds; branch tails remain eligible for duration+0.35 seconds.
timing.blackout: render.py returns an exact RGB-black image before compositing any layers when zero-based frame>=456.

plateFinishing.grade: Static RGB multipliers: board=0.58, core=0.54, foreground=0.58. Alpha channels are preserved.
plateFinishing.boardMatte: A planar projective transform is fitted from physical route XY points and calibrated screen coordinates. It projects the board boundary corners (-11.5,-15.5), (11.5,-15.5), (11.5,15.5), (-11.5,15.5) into an alpha mask, removing the lighting World's visible backdrop. The board composites over exact black.
plateFinishing.localizedEmission: addlight strength=2.4 for board-level routed signals, 2.5 for processor-level aperture/contact signals. Optical bloom uses local Gaussian spill and an exponential shoulder; it is not a global audio-level brightness gate.
plateFinishing.lineScale: Projected screen-space widths scale by s=outputWidth/sceneMetadata.width. Cable trail=4.5*s; branch signal=2.6*s; snare contact=2.6*s. Integer minimum widths preserve visibility in the low-resolution proof.

systems.kick: Envelope adds kick*0.006 to the central processor plane's camera scale and energizes its perimeter, with the same calm camera trajectory.
systems.snare: Nine localized pale-white die-contact lines; tile index=((j+route)*5)%48 for j=0..8.
systems.beast: Amber paired aperture lines on the 48 die tiles. The scored phoneme selects discrete patterns: ka alternates column banks, WOM opens a broad row pattern, glitch advances a three-bank tile pattern, and other syllables scan across columns. Source syllable ordinal also selects banks and phase; lengthSteps determines response duration. Aperture length and spacing modulate within the scored syllable. Dark slots (width=max(2,round(7*s))) appear beneath the amber gates (width=max(1,round(4*s))). Original score pitch labels remain audit metadata, not a separate pitch-to-geometry control.

visualImplementation.coalescing: Unselected coalesced rows do not create independent visual accents or add energy in this compositor. Their representative's existing routed trail continues. coalescedCount and coalescedPeakVelocity are audit metadata; render.py does not use them to increase brightness or fan-out.

proof.method: Three continuous windows sampled at every second 60-fps source frame; matching exact PCM audio windows concatenate without gain changes. This is a 3.6-second review montage, not the eight-second delivery master.

selection.policy: Major cable attacks, all Beast syllables and strong structural drums retained. Quiet ghosts/ticks omitted. Closely spaced events coalesce into active trails within two frames; no randomized flashing.
selection.note: All 361 excerpt source rows remain in events with explicit selectionReason; coalesced rows retain their authoritative timing and representative source index.
